source_coverage: Partial reconstruction from accessible conversation excerpts, memory, historical MRIE workstream artifacts and GitHub source tree. No complete raw ChatGPT transcript export. Repo audited on 2026-10-16; CI failure identified in relationships schema mismatch.
bootstrap_policy: Follow AGENTS.md#work-routing-policy for read-only work, authorized routine capture, existing-problem continuity, recorded owner transfer and new-problem claims. A new conversation alone creates no issue or branch. Do not pre-create dormant branches. Read current main and the relevant scoped branch; keep branch proposals distinct from accepted or applied policy.

global_rules.ttd: Time to Die; never present expired observations/calculations as live
global_rules.history: 200+ completed daily sessions for eligible public tickers; private entities never get synthetic OHLCV
global_rules.cross_domain_action: Use the existing receiver issue/intake and a complete source-obligation handoff under AGENTS.md#work-routing-policy; create a linked issue only if no suitable record exists. Record a receiver claim and exclusive writer before implementation; accepted intake is not completed work.
global_rules.non_merge: No direct main writes. Work on the scoped feature branch and open a draft PR; no merge, auto-merge, tag, release or deployment without explicit authorization.
global_rules.tests_policy: Unit tests follow engine/ticker domain; B01 owns integration tests, validator and CI workflow. Contract changes follow B00 and require handoffs.
global_rules.collision_policy: Check live claims, exact branch heads and actual PR changed files for file/subtree/glob overlaps. Continue with the knowledgeable branch worker; narrow, sequence or record a controller-approved transfer with exact paths and an exclusive writer before conflicting writes.
global_rules.evidence_temporality: Separate fact effective date, observation date, first available date, ingest date, period end, and expiration by data class.
global_rules.merge_readiness: Apply AGENTS.md#work-routing-policy and exact-head evidence checks. A green branch is not main integration or operational acceptance. No merge without explicit authorization; no first-release prerequisite blocks independent eligible work.
global_rules.data_plane: Runtime market observations require authenticated entitled provider + persistent worker. ChatGPT and GitHub do not themselves provide a polling runtime.
global_rules.dependency_semantics: Catalog dependencies identify contracts and necessary coordination, not automatic blockers for independent read-only research. Operational claims require actual acceptance evidence; documentation, branch checks or a release name are not proof of operation.
global_rules.bootstrap_if_unmerged: Historical key retained for catalog compatibility. The obsolete PR bootstrap exception no longer routes work. Use AGENTS.md#work-routing-policy, current main, the assigned feature branch and current GitHub issue evidence; do not create a branch merely for a new conversation.
global_rules.ci_repair_first: Historical key retained for catalog compatibility. Select priority from live GitHub issue #136 and evidence-backed owner dependencies, not the old fixed CI-repair sequence. Preserve strict validation and independent exact-head assessment.
global_rules.full_instructions_delivery: When Project Instructions are requested or changed, deliver the COMPLETE current text in ONE copyable block or one complete downloadable file. Separately identify branch, main and app-application status; never present fragments or a repository commit as proof of settings application.
global_rules.versioning_policy: Core SemVer, catalog SemVer, schema major, data append-only revisions and engine algorithm/config versions are distinct. New core releases require gates and explicit authorization.
global_rules.worker_resolution: Every worker posts the basket.worker_resolution@1 payload with acceptance IDs, CI/test outcomes and URLs, changed paths, blockers, handoffs, unknowns and next action. B00 independently validates it against fetched GitHub evidence; see orchestration/WORKER_PROTOCOL.md.
global_rules.readiness: A worker can be component verified without being integrated. A merged PR still needs main CI verification; no auto merge.
global_rules.reusable_workers: Reuse capabilities and recipes under AGENTS.md#work-routing-policy. Continue an existing problem with its canonical issue, feature branch and knowledgeable owner. Only a genuinely new problem needs a new claim/branch, reusing a matching unclaimed intake issue where available. Roles never expand write authority.
global_rules.queue_honesty: GitHub Issues, starting at #136, are the working queue; Projects is an optional projection and queue.json is historical/planned input. Fetch actual issue/PR/check evidence. A draft PR or role name does not prove an active worker, readiness or completion.
global_rules.worker_learning: Each attempt logs a concrete step, success/failure, evidence, resolution, retry ancestry, and measured (not invented) effort. QC rejects unsupported passes/claimed efficiency; adopted lessons require successful retries. Resolve problems and blockers using AGENTS.md#small-reusable-blocks-and-complete-handoffs; reuse proven patterns.
